name: model_stats
description: model_stats must aggregate the token-usage log through the host-side ck_stats and answer ok:true whether or not any usage has been recorded yet — a missing state/token_stats.jsonl aggregates to an empty stats list, not an error. The assertion is only the ok field, so the case is indifferent to how much the harness has actually spent; it goes red when the module wiring (ck_stats denied, aggregation error) breaks, which is exactly the failure that would otherwise hide behind a green build.
prompt: Use the model_stats tool with input {}. Look at the tool's JSON result and reply with only the value of its "ok" field: true or false.
